formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G0 : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x : Fin n → Bool), (∀ i < G0.length, ∀ w ∈ (G0.getD i ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, []⟩).inputs, w < n + i) → (∀ i : ℕ, ((⟨G0 ++ C.gates.map (fun g => ({ op := g.op, inputs := g.inputs.map (fun w => if w < n then w else w + G0.length) } : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate)), C.output⟩ : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit).wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (if i < n then i else i + G0.length) false = (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD i false) ∧ (∀ i < G0.length, ((⟨G0 ++ C.gates.map (fun g => ({ op := g.op, inputs := g.inputs.map (fun w => if w < n then w else w + G0.length) } : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate)), C.output⟩ : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit).wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (n + i) false = ((⟨G0, 0⟩ : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit).wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (n + i) false)
plain_statement: G0 is a list of gates in which gate i reads only wires below n + i (inputs and earlier gates of G0). C is any circuit on n inputs. Build D: the gates of G0, then the gates of C with every read index i at or above n replaced by i + |G0| (inputs keep their index); the output index is left as it is (no conclusion reads it). Then on every input x, every wire i of C has the value of wire shift(i) of D, and the wire n + i of D, for i below |G0|, has the value of wire n + i of the circuit made of G0 alone.
title: Prepending gates: a gate list put in front of a circuit, every later read shifted by its length, keeps every old wire's value and adds the prefix's wires
